question: Name the Indian state that is known as the 'Land of High Passes'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ladakh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ladakh**, located in the northernmost region of India, is popularly known as the **'Land of High Passes'**. The name "Ladakh" itself is derived from the Tibetan term "La-dvags," which translates to "land of high passes."
 
• This region is famous for its **rugged terrain, high-altitude mountain passes, and stunning landscapes**. Some of the well-known passes in Ladakh include **Khardung La**, **Chang La**, and **Zoji La**.
 
• **Geographical Location:** Ladakh is situated in the northern part of the Indian subcontinent, bordered by the **Karakoram Range** in the north and the **Himalayas** in the south. It is one of the highest inhabited regions in the world.
 
• Ladakh became a separate union territory of India on **October 31, 2019**, after the bifurcation of the state of Jammu and Kashmir under the **Jammu and Kashmir Reorganization Act, 2019**.
 
• The region is known for its unique **Buddhist culture**, monasteries, and festivals, making it a popular destination for tourists.
 
• The passes in Ladakh play a crucial role in connecting the region with the rest of India and neighboring countries, facilitating both trade and tourism. For example, **Khardung La** is often touted as one of the highest motorable roads in the world.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Other Indian States in the Options:**

 
 
• **Himachal Pradesh:** Located in the western Himalayas, Himachal Pradesh is known for its scenic beauty and hill stations like Shimla and Manali. It is not referred to as the 'Land of High Passes,' but it does have notable passes like **Rohtang Pass**.
 
• **Uttarakhand:** This northern Indian state is known as the "Land of Gods" due to its many pilgrimage sites such as **Kedarnath** and **Badrinath**. It is not associated with the title 'Land of High Passes.'
 
• **Sikkim:** Located in the northeastern part of India, Sikkim is known for its monasteries and biodiversity. It is home to passes like **Nathu La**, but it is not referred to as the 'Land of High Passes.'
 
 
 
• **Important Features of Ladakh:**
 
 
• Ladakh is characterized by its **cold desert climate**, with low precipitation and extreme temperature variations.
 
• The region is home to unique wildlife like the **snow leopard**, **Tibetan antelope**, and **yak**.
 
• It also hosts famous landmarks such as the **Pangong Lake**, **Magnetic Hill**, and **Leh Palace**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Khardung La Pass:** At an altitude of around **5,359 meters**, it is a vital gateway to the Nubra Valley and a popular attraction for adventure enthusiasts.
 
• **Chang La Pass:** This pass is located at an altitude of **5,360 meters** and is en route to Pangong Lake.
 
• **Zoji La Pass:** Situated at **3,528 meters**, this pass connects Ladakh to Kashmir and is vital for trade and connectivity.
 
• **Cultural Significance:** Ladakh is deeply rooted in Tibetan Buddhist traditions, with monasteries like **Hemis**, **Thiksey**, and **Diskit** being prominent spiritual centers.
